wiki.title: Yeti
wiki.text:
Yetis are ape-like creatures that live primarily in the Hot Springs Haven, they enjoy rock music and penguin bowling. Like robgoblins, most yetis are mostly enemies with a few rare NPC yetis. At the moment there are no quests giving yetis.
